note: The ten prohibited-file blob hashes, recorded before any code in this run was touched (HEAD == main == 22713e311765714be635e485719d34d9892e9a8f, worktree clean at the time). Committed here -- unlike .harness/runs/<id>/capabilities.json, which check-prohibited.sh originally read this from -- because .harness/runs/ is gitignored: once that run directory is cleaned up, a check that reads only from there hard-FAILs for everyone, including whoever is running this checker after the run that wrote it is gone. This file is the same ten (path, blob-sha) pairs, copied verbatim from that run's capabilities.json.prohibitedFilesBaseline.blobs so the check keeps working after the run record does not.
